title: Us
description: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

title: Companion
description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
description: A fatherless teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon, his wife and two children. The full scope of his intent soon becomes menacingly clear when he confronts the doctor with a long-forgotten transgression.

title: The Hangover Part II
description: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand.

title: Game Night
description: A couple's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when their friends agree to participate in a murder mystery party. They soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

title: Batman
description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson).

title: Batman Returns
description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot.

title: Batman Forever
description: The Caped Crusader (Val Kilmer) woos a criminal psychologist, takes on a sidekick and battles Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones) and the Riddler (Jim Carrey).

title: Batman & Robin
description: Batgirl joins the caped crusaders (George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell) to stop Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Poison Ivy from wreaking revenge upon the world.

title: Joker
description: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Joker: Folie à Deux
description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
description: Harley Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask and every other thug in Gotham. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth.

title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
description: Human survivors of a plague threaten Caesar's growing nation of genetically evolved apes. Though they reach a fragile peace, soon both sides are brought to the brink of a war that will determine which will become Earth's dominant species.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

title: A Clockwork Orange
description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society.

title: Body at Brighton Rock
description: A part-time state park employee faces her worst fears as she guards the site of a potential crime scene deep in the wilderness.

title: The Predator
description: In Shane Black's explosive reinvention, the Predator is deadlier than ever, and only a ragtag crew can prevent the end of the human race.

title: Ocean's 11
description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve.

title: Ocean's Eleven
description: Dapper Danny Ocean organizes a gang to steal $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos in a single heist.

title: Ocean's Twelve
description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe.

title: Ocean's Thirteen
description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor.

title: Ocean's Eight
description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger.

title: Trap
description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert.

title: The Watchers
description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman.

title: Son of Godzilla
description: A scientist's experiments heat up an island as well as Godzilla's egg, hatching a son, Minya.

title: Full Metal Jacket
description: A Marine (Matthew Modine) and his companions (Adam Baldwin, Vincent D'Onofrio) endure basic training under a sadistic drill sergeant and fight in the 1968 Tet offensive.

title: Scanners
description: A scientist (Patrick McGoohan) sends a "scanner" (Stephen Lack) to hunt others like him with explosive psychic powers.

title: It
description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

title: The Adjustment Bureau
description: After glimpsing his future, an ambitious politician (Matt Damon) battles the agents of Fate itself to be with the woman (Emily Blunt) he loves.

title: Room
description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.

title: Arctic
description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive.

title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

title: Dumb Money
description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock.

title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

title: Due Date
description: Desperate to reach his pregnant wife (Michelle Monaghan), a high-strung architect (Robert Downey Jr.) takes a road trip home with an annoying stranger (Zach Galifianakis).

title: Collision Course
description: A Japanese detective (Pat Morita) and a Detroit detective (Jay Leno) team up to recover a stolen top-secret turbocharger.

title: Fantastic Planet
description: The 39-foot-tall pastel Draags keep leashes on the Oms, their tiny pets descended from humans.

title: A History of Violence
description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner.

title: Enemy
description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.
